Definition: a Tsorite or inhabitant of Tsor (i.e. Syrian)
BiblicalUsage: A Tyrian is a man of Tyre, the Phoenician city whose king sent cedar and craftsmen to Solomon. In 1 Kings 7:14, his father was a man of Tyre.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Tyrian shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
